title: VaultPay
longDescription:
A secure financial processing backend designed for scale and high availability.

Traditional payment backends face severe scaling bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities when processing high-throughput transactions under burst loads.

Microservices architecture deployed on a managed Kubernetes cluster, utilizing a highly available PostgreSQL cluster for ACID-compliant transactions, and Redis for a high-speed caching layer.

Engineered robust CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Terraform to provision infrastructure as code. This approach reduced manual deployment errors to zero and ensured 100% environment consistency across staging and production.
